subject.title: [Bug]: Agent heartbeat routes to wrong agent's session instead of its own

question: Should global-scope heartbeats preserve a secondary agent's own store/session identity, or intentionally keep using the literal global/default-agent session for all agents?
rationale: Source and reporter evidence support a remaining bug, but changing global session/store semantics is compatibility-sensitive and needs owner intent plus live proof before an automated fix PR.

options.title: Live repro, then targeted fix
options.body: Reproduce the WSL2/Docker global-scope case on current main, then queue a narrow fix with regression coverage for secondary-agent heartbeat identity under global scope.

options.title: Queue source-level fix now
options.body: Accept the source evidence as sufficient and let a repair PR attempt a focused fix plus tests before live repro is available.

options.title: Keep global sharing documented
options.body: Decide that global scope intentionally shares the default/global heartbeat session and document the per-agent heartbeat limitation plus the per-sender workaround.

recommendation.title: Live repro, then targeted fix
recommendation.body: Reproduce the WSL2/Docker global-scope case on current main, then queue a narrow fix with regression coverage for secondary-agent heartbeat identity under global scope.
